annotations.text:
The site is only the Calculation Desk now.
The open question is the top of the page — the two artboards answer it differently. Both use the real tokens from index.html.
Desk-first: no gauge, no About. A visitor is reading calculators within one screen. Trade-off — nothing proves the tool works until you scroll.
Instrument-first: keeps the live earned-value gauge, so the page demonstrates itself before describing itself. Trade-off — the desk proper starts ~600px lower.
